sampling_intervals_s.interpretation: The two long gaps are present identically in wall timestamps and elapsed_s; no suspend-clock discrepancy is measurable from this receipt.

owned_cpu_recorded.qualitative: Recorded per-process pcpu values are observable for owned descendants only; they are not a whole-system CPU measurement.
owned_cpu_recorded.global_swap: The vm.swapusage lines are retained in the source but are global host state and are not attributable to this run.

parser_method: Count sample_utc records; pair each with the following filesystem Available field and owned_rss_sum_kib field; compare UTC timestamp deltas with elapsed_s deltas; scan owned process rows for pcpu maxima. No raw trace, solver, or other artifact was opened or changed.
